request.state: Server-rendered CanLang pages update via HTMX partials. Normative rules: mutation-driven re-reads of authorized regions must not disturb unrelated unsaved controls or focus; correctable validation failures retain input; conflicts display current values without overwriting; retained state (values, validation/conflict markers, focus, open details) covers only still-authorized content, and revoked private values must be dropped even at the cost of a draft; poll-triggered rereads touch read regions only. The toolkit contains state-merging swaps (keep live input and focus, cannot reset), subtree freeze markers paired with replacing swaps, plain replacing swaps, and existing server echo of submitted values on failure. Candidate A: merge-based swapping as the norm on stable region ids, replacement reserved for deliberate reset. Candidate B: replacement as the norm with freeze markers maintained on all draft-bearing subtrees. Candidate C: server-kept drafts per session and page merged into each render.

preservation.instructions: Which candidate most reliably upholds every normative rule above, weighing the cost of a missed marker, a stale morph, and server-held draft state?

criteria.A: Merging swaps as the norm on stable region ids; replacement only for deliberate reset.
criteria.B: Replacing swaps as the norm; freeze markers on all draft-bearing subtrees.
criteria.C: Server-kept per-session per-page drafts merged into each render.
